chamra_universal: On Day 4, Matthias Universal arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
colemarkpearson: Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear found a place in R-F15 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Benedikt Durham and Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At relief, the next watch was told it had been a good hour.
Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear kept watch so that Edmund "Whistle" Es could sleep. Then Whistle kept watch so that Saint could. Neither slept.
jake_the_snake6424: Clement Snake told the sergeant he was a shepherd. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Clement Snake bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
martinsatalik: At the depot, Severin Martinsatali had practised answering to his name. At S-F7, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Severin Martinsatali shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Severin Martinsatali washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
noel_cocac: Jakub "Ash" Cocac reached S-F17 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Jakub "Ash" Cocac let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Jakub "Ash" Cocac and Bram Archiegregor made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
vuminhtri260709: Nobody asked Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri why he came. Nobody in S-F11 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.

Gideon Allistofeari of the Hegemony and Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Brickworks all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri held the mirror while Isidor Jackmdunn shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
